checkInIntro: Let your family know how you are. They'll see it in the family activity.
checkInOptionOkHint: To let them know you arrived or that all is well.
checkInOptionHelpHint: To ask for support when it's not an emergency.
checkInSosExplainer: Is it an emergency? Use SOS: it sends an alert to your family's phones.
checkInMessageRemaining: {count, plural, =0{No characters left} =1{1 character left} other{{count} characters left}}
checkInMessageTooLong: The message can be up to {max} characters.
checkInIncludeLocationExact: Your current location will be included.
checkInIncludeLocationApprox: Your approximate location will be included.
checkInIncludeLocationOffExact: If you turn this on, your current location will be included.
checkInIncludeLocationOffApprox: If you turn this on, your approximate location will be included.
checkInLocationNotShared: Your location won't be included: you don't share it with this family.
checkInSendingBody: It's saved on this phone. Waiting for the server to confirm.
checkInQueuedTitle: Saved. It will be sent when you're back online.
checkInQueuedBody: It's saved on this phone. You don't need to send it again.
checkInDeliveredBody: It's now in the family activity. This doesn't confirm that anyone has seen it yet.
checkInFailedBody: The server didn't accept it. You can retry or discard it.
checkInLocationOmitted: We couldn't get your location, so it goes without it.
checkInOfflineBanner: You're offline. It will be saved and sent when you're back online.
checkInNoFamily: Create or join a family to send a check-in.
checkInErrorNotSaved: We couldn't save it on this phone. Please try again.
checkInErrorNotFound: That check-in is no longer pending.
checkInErrorSending: It's being sent right now, so it can't be discarded.
